verdict.rationale: Cake documents connecting Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client so you can ask about shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes in plain English, answered from the live cap table. The docs state this access is "All read-only", so natural language can query the product but cannot operate it (issue grants, record transactions, run approvals). Missing for 10: natural-language write/action capabilities, documentation of command scope beyond Q&A, independent or hands-on corroboration.
